name: Musée Yves Saint Laurent Marrakech
known: Run by the Fondation Jardin Majorelle, created by decree no. 2.11.647 of 4 November 2011 and chaired by Madison Cox in 2022 (foundation press release, 15 November 2022).

name: L'Appartement 22
known: Founded in 2002 (October 2002, according to Contemporary And) by the independent curator Abdellah Karroum.
Its retrospective "L'appartement 22 (2002-2022)," curated by Karroum, ran from 11 October 2022 to 7 January 2023 at Lot 219 in Fès, Morocco (Kohllective).
Founder's other role: Karroum was appointed director of Mathaf: Arab Museum of Modern Art in Doha, Qatar, in June 2013 (C&, 2013).
Curatorial Research, Radio R22 Broadcasting & Trans-African Dialogue

name: Le Cube – independent art room
known: Residencies began in 2007, the "summers lab" for young Moroccan artists in 2011, the "curators zone" in 2013, and since 2021 it also works as a nomadic project, Le Cube expanded (Le Cube).
